text:
## Regulatory Breaches  
**Breach Consequences:**
- ICO fine: Up to £20 million or 4% of annual turnover (whichever higher)
- Reputational damage
- Customer trust loss
- Internal disciplinary action

raw_entities.description: The Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) is the UK's independent authority for data protection. The ICO has authority to impose financial penalties for regulatory breaches, with fines reaching up to £20 million or 4% of annual turnover, whichever is higher.
context: ICO fine: Up to £20 million or 4% of annual turnover (whichever higher)

raw_entities.description: Failure to comply with regulatory requirements, resulting in potential financial penalties, reputational damage, and loss of customer trust. The document identifies regulatory breaches as a material risk with significant consequences.
context: Breach Consequences: ICO fine: Up to £20 million or 4% of annual turnover (whichever higher)

raw_entities.name: Reputational Damage
raw_entities.description: Loss of market standing and public confidence resulting from regulatory breaches or compliance failures. The document identifies reputational damage as a direct consequence of regulatory non-compliance.

raw_entities.name: Customer Trust Loss

raw_entities.description: The organisation will take internal disciplinary action against staff or management responsible for regulatory breaches. This provision establishes accountability and consequences for non-compliance at the individual level.
